summary.zh: 我是郭銍恩，歡迎叫我注音，碩士期間獨立建置讓學生以手寫、繪圖與文字和 AI 互動的數學解題系統，也曾以 Unity 開發數位教育遊戲、參與農作物影像辨識競賽。
summary.en: My name is Chih-En Kuo, and you’re welcome to call me Zhuyin. During my master’s studies, I independently built a mathematics problem-solving system that lets students interact with AI through handwriting, drawings, and text. My other projects include educational games built with Unity and a crop image classification competition.

about.zh:
我本名是郭銍恩，歡迎叫我注音，目前已碩士畢業。國小有了自己的電腦後，開始好奇網路與軟體如何運作，國中時因一台使用體驗不佳的 Android 平板而查找刷機方法，動手嘗試 Recovery，並接觸 Linux 與命令列；遇到問題時查找資料、反覆嘗試的過程，逐漸養成自己動手解決問題的習慣。高中接觸 C、Java、Python、SQL 與 PHP，也開始經營部落格。

大學就讀亞洲大學行動商務與多媒體應用學系，並完成資訊工程學系雙主修，當時也曾選修心理學課程，透過 WordPress 建立自己的網站；專案方面，以 Unity 與 C# 開發數位教育遊戲，並以 Python 與 PyTorch 參與農作物影像辨識競賽。

碩士就讀國立中央大學網路學習科技研究所，期間獨立建置論文中的數學解題系統，整合互動畫布、PHP 後端、MySQL 資料紀錄、AI 代理協作與提示詞策略，讓學生以手寫、繪圖和文字呈現解題歷程、與 AI 協作解決問題。
about.en:
My name is Chih-En Kuo, and you’re welcome to call me Zhuyin. I am a recent master’s graduate. Having my own computer in elementary school sparked an interest in software and the internet. In junior high, a slow Android tablet led me to research firmware flashing, try Recovery, and explore Linux and the command line; looking up answers and trying different approaches gradually became a habit for working through problems. High school brought C, Java, Python, SQL, PHP, and my first blog.

At Asia University, I studied M-Commerce and Multimedia Application, completed a second major in Computer Science and Information Engineering, and took psychology electives. I also built my own WordPress website, developed educational games with Unity and C#, and entered a crop image classification competition using Python and PyTorch.

I then pursued a master’s degree at National Central University’s Graduate Institute of Network Learning Technology. During those studies, I independently built the mathematics problem-solving system for my thesis, integrating an interactive canvas, a PHP backend, MySQL records, AI-agent coordination, and prompt strategies so students could express their reasoning through handwriting, drawings, and text while collaborating with AI.

interests.zh:
平時會閱讀科技資訊，關注手機、穿戴裝置與電腦硬體等產品發展，休閒喜歡旅遊、象棋、黑白棋、單車、羽球與保齡球。高中畢業後，完成期待已久的單車環島，並把沿途故事記在部落格，參加研討會時也喜歡安排時間認識當地。

在不同的兒童營隊，曾與孩子一起生火煮飯、玩大地遊戲、蓋樹屋，陪伴他們以單車完成花蓮到臺東的路程，也協助 Minecraft 程式設計與 Python、APCS 考試輔導；這些經驗讓我發現自己喜歡與孩子相處，也曾在教會擔任兒童陪讀志工。
interests.en:
I follow technology news, especially phones, wearables, and computer hardware, and enjoy travelling, chess, Reversi, cycling, badminton, and bowling. After high school, I fulfilled a long-held wish to cycle around Taiwan and recorded the journey on my blog; conference trips also offer opportunities to explore new places.

Across different children’s camps, I have joined children in making fires, cooking, outdoor games, and building treehouses, accompanied them on a cycling trip from Hualien to Taitung, and helped with Minecraft programming and Python and APCS exam preparation. Those experiences helped me discover how much I enjoy spending time with children, alongside volunteering in a church reading program.
